title: Nvidia Embeds AI in Telecom Networks via First Live AI-RAN Call
summary:
Nine telecom operators in Europe, the Middle East, and Africa are building or expanding Nvidia-powered infrastructure to run AI closer to end users. The company is deploying computing hardware across data centers, metro sites, and cell sites to shift AI inference to the network edge, Nvidia announced at GTC Berlin. As part of this expansion, T-Mobile completed the world's first AI-RAN call on a live network in collaboration with Nokia.

BT, Deutsche Telekom, and Elisa have also started live-network AI-RAN pilots using Nokia software to integrate AI into their networks. CEO Jensen Huang stated that these networks "will also carry the world's intelligence," a strategy intended to move Nvidia's hardware into a new market beyond the traditional data center.
